events.title: Neurodivergence: Quirks, Compassion, and Clinical Terms (Free Discussion Night)
events.description: Questions That Matter (Free Weekly Wed 6pm Meetup Group) “You're so OCD." "She’s autistic as f…." “They’re a little on the spectrum."  Neurodivergent language can be casual shorthand for anything we might find annoying, obsessive, or socially clumsy. Meanwhile, people who are actually autistic, ADHD, dyslexic, or otherwise neurodivergent are moving through the world with strategies most of us never have to think about: masking\*, compensating, exhausting themselves to appear "normal" enough to be taken seriously. events.description: Questions That Matter (Free Weekly Wed 6pm Meetup Group) Memento mori — "remember that you will die." We've medicalized it, institutionalized it, and outsourced it to hospitals and funeral homes so that people in much of the developed world can reach middle age without ever being in the same room as a corpse.
